onboarding_welcome_tagline: Private, encrypted expense tracking — by voice, by scanning a receipt, or straight from a bank notification.
onboarding_bullet1_title: Three ways to capture an expense
onboarding_bullet1_desc: Speak it to Vox Commander, scan a receipt with Vox Vision, or let a bank notification suggest one for you to approve.
onboarding_bullet2_desc: Set a budget per category and get alerted before you overspend; totals convert into your home currency.
onboarding_bullet3_desc: Your expenses never leave your phone unless you export them yourself.
onboarding_permissions_intro: Grant this so Vox Expenses can alert you about spending limits and confirm voice-captured expenses, even in the background. You can change it later in your device Settings.
permission_notif_desc: Needed for the spending-limit alert and the "expense saved" confirmation toast for voice-captured expenses.
permission_location_desc: Optional — lets a captured expense (voice, scan, or manual) prefill its location with your current city. You can always edit or clear it.
no_expenses_yet: No expenses yet. Tap + to add one.
delete_expense_message: This expense and its line items will be permanently deleted.
delete_item_message: This line item will be removed.
delete_category_message: Expenses in this category will become uncategorized. The expenses themselves are not deleted.
cleanup_confirm_message: The following field(s) contain only symbols or the text "null":
require_fingerprint_desc: Expenses stay encrypted at rest; this gates reading them in the app and via VoxCommander
default_currency_desc: Assigned to a new expense when you haven't picked one
decimal_separator_desc: Which character amount/quantity/price fields use — independent of your device's language
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
debug_toasts_desc: Show on-screen popups for system events and background tasks
vat_display_desc: Show and edit per-item net/VAT/gross amounts when a receipt provides them
merchant_category_memory_desc: After correcting a merchant's category the same way repeatedly, apply it automatically next time
voice_save_toast: Toast when an expense is saved
voice_save_toast_desc: Show a confirmation (amount + category) when VoxCommander saves an expense
default_voice_category_desc: Expenses without a resolved category go here
auto_create_voice_category_desc: If a guessed category doesn't exist, create it (auto-colored) instead of falling back
retry_cleanup_no_saved_text: No saved scan text to retry — please rescan the receipt
commander_required_message: This feature requires Vox Commander to be installed and configured
vision_required_message: This feature requires Vox Vision to be installed
auto_merge_categories_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find near-duplicate categories for you to review
auto_merge_categories_need_two: Add at least 2 categories to use Auto-Merge
auto_merge_categories_sent_toast: Looking for duplicate categories — check back here shortly
scheduled_merge_desc: Look for duplicate categories automatically on a schedule (still requires your review before anything merges)
duplicate_entry_error: Duplicate entry — an identical expense already exists
find_duplicate_expenses_desc: Ask VoxCommander's AI to find expenses that look like the same purchase logged twice
find_duplicate_expenses_need_two: Add at least 2 expenses to use this
find_duplicate_expenses_sent_toast: Looking for duplicates — check back here shortly
scheduled_dedup_desc: Also run the manual check above on a recurring schedule — uses whichever mode is selected there, and still stages suggestions for your review.
expense_cleanup_section_desc: Catch expenses that were saved twice — from voice, scan, manual entry, or captured bank notifications.
duplicate_check_automatic_desc: What runs every time a new expense is saved. Local merges obvious duplicates silently; AI-involving modes also fire a small, scoped check whose result waits for your review below.
duplicate_check_manual_desc: Which engine "Check for duplicates now" (and the schedule below) uses.
auto_accept_duplicate_merges_desc: When the scoped, insert-time AI check confirms a duplicate, merge it immediately instead of waiting for your review. Never affects the manual check or the schedule — those always stage suggestions for review.
near_duplicate_merged_message: Merged with a similar existing expense.
home_currency_desc: Reports convert mixed-currency expenses into this currency at report time
exchange_rate_api_key_desc: Free key from %1$s — only used when a report needs to convert a different currency
exchange_rate_service_missing: external_services.json is missing the exchange-rate entry
notification_capture_desc: Automatically detect payments from notifications of apps you pick below (e.g. your banking app) and propose them as expenses for you to review — nothing is created automatically unless you enable auto-accept below.
battery_optimization_warning: Some phones kill background apps aggressively, which can silently drop a payment notification before it's captured. Exempting this app from battery optimization keeps it running reliably in the background.
payment_source_apps_desc: Only notifications from apps checked below are ever inspected — everything else is ignored
auto_accept_notification_expenses_desc: Skip the review step — a successfully parsed notification is saved straight away as a normal expense (still editable afterward) instead of waiting for you to approve it.
spending_limits_desc: Checked daily; you'll get a notification the first time a limit is exceeded in a given week/month
calendar_view_desc: Browse expenses as a scrollable, month-paged calendar instead of a plain list
widget_border_enabled_desc: Draw an outline around each day's group of records in the home-screen widget.
attach_photo_on_scan: Process photo with AI on scan
attach_photo_on_scan_desc: Send the receipt photo to the AI alongside the recognized text (needs Vision's "send photo to AI" setting on too, and a multimodal engine configured)
attach_photo_on_retry: Process photo with AI on retry
attach_photo_on_retry_desc: Also send the photo when retrying a failed scan's cleanup, not just on the first attempt
auto_open_scanned_expense_desc: Jump straight to the new expense's edit screen for review as soon as a scanned receipt finishes processing, instead of staying on the list.
location_prefill_desc: Auto-fill an expense's location field with your current city (scan, voice, and manual entry). Turn off to stop this entirely, without revoking the location permission itself.
delete_all_expenses_desc: Permanently remove all expense records from this device
delete_all_confirm_message: This will permanently delete every expense record and line item. This action cannot be undone.
